cpu_baseline: original random-access EF select retained in cpu_ms; forward high-bit cursor with adjacent boundary reuse and popcount skips in cpu_forward_ms; both use production EF output encoder
input_contract: validated generated files plus explicit sorted due-cancellation ordinals, target identity/count and canceled payload-byte sum
complete_output_checks: all outputs compared byte-for-byte with CPU oracle; all passed
correctness: 24 cases pass CTest and host ASan+UBSan with real Metal
host_contention: main build/regression/package lane explicitly released before measurements; no experiment compilation concurrent with runs
repeated_median_margin_criterion: first tested balanced input size with CPU-forward/GPU median ratio >=1.2 in both runs; sample ranges can overlap, not a latency guarantee
